chapters: In the eighth month in the second year of Daryavesh, the word of Havayah came to Zecharyah son of Berechyah, son of Iddo the prophet, saying:
The Havayah was wroth with your fathers, for they provoked Him.
And you shall say to them: So Havayah of Hosts said, Return to Me, Havayah of Hosts said, and I will return to you, Havayah of Hosts said.

Be not like your fathers, to whom the early prophets called, saying: So Havayah of Hosts said: Return now from your evil ways and your evil deeds. But they neither obeyed nor hearkened to Me, Havayah said.
As for your fathers — where are they? But the prophets — do they live forever?

But My words and My decrees that I commanded My servants, the prophets — did they not overtake your fathers? And they returned and said: "As Havayah of Hosts planned to do to us, according to our ways and according to our deeds, so He did to us."

On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month — that is, the month of Shevat — in the second year of Daryavesh, the word of Havayah came to Zecharyah the son of Berechyah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying:
I saw tonight, and behold! A man was riding on a red horse, and he was standing among the myrtles that were in the pool, and after him were red, black, and white horses.
And I said, "What are these, my master?" and the angel who was speaking to me said to me, "I will show you what these are."
And the man standing among the myrtles replied and said, "These are the ones whom Havayah has sent to walk to and fro on the earth."
And they answered the angel of Havayah who was standing among the myrtles, and they said, "We have walked to and fro on the earth, and behold! All the earth sits still and is at rest."
And the angel of Havayah replied and said, "O Havayah of Hosts! How long will You not have mercy on Yerushalayim and upon the cities of Yehudah, upon whom You are wroth for seventy years already?"
And Havayah answered the angel who was speaking to me, good words — yea, consoling words.
And the angel who was speaking to me said to me, "Proclaim, saying: 'So Havayah of Hosts said, I am jealous for Yerushalayim, and for Tziyon — great jealousy.
And I am very angry with the nations that are at ease, for I was wroth a little, and they helped to do harm.'
Therefore, so Havayah said: 'I have returned to Yerushalayim with mercy; My house shall be built there,' Havayah of Hosts says. 'And a plumb line shall be stretched out over Yerushalayim.'
Further, proclaim, saying: so Havayah of Hosts said, 'My cities shall yet spread out with prosperity, and Havayah shall yet console Tziyon and shall yet choose Yerushalayim.' "
And I lifted my eyes, and I saw — and behold!-four horns.
And I said to the angel who was speaking to me, "What are these?" And he said to me, "These are the horns that scattered Yehudah and Yisroel and Yerushalayim."
And Havayah showed me four craftsmen.

And I said, "What are these coming to do?" And he said, saying, "These are the horns that scattered Yehudah to the extent that no man raised his head. And these came to cause them to quake, to cast away the horns of the nations that bear a horn against the land of Yehudah, to scatter it."
And I lifted my eyes, and I saw — and behold!-a man with a measuring line in his hand.
And I said, "Where are you going?" And he said to me, "To measure Yerushalayim, to see how much is its breadth and how much is its length."
And behold, the angel who was speaking with me was coming forth, and another angel was coming forth toward him.
And he said to him, "Run, speak to this young man, saying: 'Yerushalayim shall be inhabited like unwalled towns, because of the multitude of men and cattle therein.' "
But I will be for it — Havayah says — a wall of fire around, and for glory I will be in its midst.
Ho, ho! Flee from the land of the north, Havayah says; for I have spread you as the four corners of the heavens, Havayah says.
Ho, Tziyon! Flee, she who sits among the nation of Bavel.
For so Havayah of Hosts said: After glory, He sent me to the nations that plunder you, for whoever touches you touches the apple of his eye.
For, behold! I raise My hand over them, and they shall be prey for those who serve them. And you shall know that Havayah of Hosts sent me.
Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Tziyon, for, behold! I will come and dwell in your midst, Havayah says.
And many nations shall join Havayah on that day, and they shall be My people; and I will dwell in your midst and you shall know that Havayah of Hosts sent me to you.
And Havayah shall inherit Yehudah as His share on the Holy Land, and He shall again choose Yerushalayim.
Silence all flesh from before Havayah, for He is aroused out of His holy habitation.
And He showed me Yehoshua, the High Priest, standing before the angel of Havayah. And Satan was standing on his right, to accuse him.
And Havayah said to Satan: The Havayah shall rebuke you, O Satan; and Havayah shall rebuke you, He who chose Yerushalayim. Is this one not a brand plucked from fire?
Now Yehoshua was wearing filthy garments and standing before the angel.

And he the angel raised his voice and said to those standing before him, saying, "Take the filthy garments off him." And he said to him, "See, I have removed your iniquity from you, and I have clad you with clean garments."
And I said, "Let them put a pure miter on his head," and they put the pure miter on his head. And they had clothed him with garments while the angel of Havayah was standing.
And the angel of Havayah warned Yehoshua, saying,

So Havayah of Hosts said: If you walk in My ways, and if you keep My charge, you, too, shall judge My house, and you, too, shall guard My courtyards, and I will give you free access among these who stand by.
Hearken, now, O Yehoshua the High Priest — you and your companions who sit before you, for they are men worthy of a miracle — for, behold! I bring My servant, the Shoot.

For, behold the stone that I have placed before Yehoshua. Seven eyes are directed to one stone. Behold! I untie its knots, Havayah of Hosts says, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
On that day, Havayah of Hosts says, you shall call — each man to his neighbor — to come under his vine and under his fig tree.
And the angel who spoke with me returned, and he awakened me as a man who wakes up from his sleep.

And he said to me, "What do you see?" And I said, "I saw, and behold there was a candelabrum all of gold, with its oil-bowl on top of it, and its seven lamps thereon; seven tubes each to the lamps that were on top of it.
And there were two olive trees near it; one on the right of the bowl, and one on its left.
So I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, "What are these, my master?"
And the angel who spoke with me answered, and he said to me, "Do you not know what these are?" And I said, "No, my master."
And he answered and spoke to me, saying, "This is the word of Havayah to Zerubavel, saying: 'Not by military force and not by physical strength, but by My spirit,' Havayah of Hosts says.
Who are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubavel you sink to a plain! He will bring out the stone of the main architect, with shouts of grace, grace to it."
And the word of Havayah came to me, saying:
Zerubavel's hands founded this house, and his hands shall complete it, and you shall know that Havayah of Hosts sent me to you.
For, whoever despised the day of small things shall rejoice and see the plummet in Zerubavel's hand; these, sevenfold; the eyes of Havayah are roving to and fro throughout all the earth.
And I raised my voice and said to him, "What are these two olive trees on the right of the candelabrum and on its left?"
And I raised my voice a second time and said to him, "What are the two olive branches beside the two golden vats that empty out the golden oil from themselves?"
And he spoke to me, saying, "Do you not know what these are?" And I said, "No, my master."
And he said, "These are the two anointed ones who stand before Havayah of all the earth."
And I returned, and I lifted my eyes and saw — and behold!-there was a flying scroll.
And he said to me, "What do you see?" and I said, "I see a flying scroll, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide."
And he said to me; This is the curse that comes forth upon the face of the entire land; for, whoever stole was cleared from such as this, and whoever swore was cleared from such as this.

I have brought it forth, Havayah of Hosts says, and it shall come into the house of the thief and into the house of him that swears in My Name falsely. And it shall lodge in the midst of his house and destroy him, and his wood, and his stones.
And the angel who was speaking to me came forth, and he said to me, "Now lift up your eyes and see what this is that is coming forth."
And I said, "What is it?" And he said, "This is the ephah that is going forth." And he said, "This is the punishment of those whose eye gazes over the entire land."
And behold! A talent of lead was being lifted, and this one woman was sitting in the midst of the ephah.
And he said, "This is Wickedness. " And he cast her into the midst of the ephah, and he cast the lead weight into her mouth.

And I lifted my eyes, and I saw — and behold!-two women were coming forth with wind in their wings, and they had wings like the wings of the stork. And they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
And I said to the angel who spoke to me, "Where are they taking the ephah?"
And he said to me, "To build a house for it in the land of Shinar, and it will be prepared, and they shall place it there on its base."
And I returned and lifted my eyes and saw — and behold!- four chariots were coming forth from between the two mountains, and the mountains were mountains of copper.
In the first chariot were red horses, and in the second chariot were black horses.
And in the third chariot were white horses, and in the fourth chariot were spotted, ash-colored horses.
And I raised my voice and said to the angel who spoke to me, "What are these, my master?"
And the angel replied and said to me, "These are the four corners of the heavens coming forth from standing beside Havayah of the entire earth."
The one chariot the black horses were in was going forth to the northland, and the white ones went forth after them. And the spotted ones went forth to the southland.
And the ash-colored ones went forth and begged to go to walk to and fro on the earth. And He said, "Go, walk to and fro on the earth." And they walked to and fro on the earth.
And he cried out to me, saying, "Look, those going forth to the northland have eased My spirit in the northland."
And the word of Havayah came to me, saying:

Take from the exiles — from Cheldai and from Toviyah and from Yedayah — and you, yourself, shall come on that day, and you shall come to the house of Yoshiyahu the son of Tzefanyah, who have come from Bavel.
And you shall take silver and gold, and you shall make crowns, and place them upon the head of Yehoshua the son of Yehozadak, the High Priest.
And you shall speak to him, saying, "So Havayah of Hosts said, saying: Behold a man whose name is the Shoot, who will spring up out of his place and build the Temple of Havayah.
And he shall build the Temple of Havayah, and he shall bear glory. And he shall sit and rule on his throne, and the priest shall be on his throne. And a counsel of peace shall be between them both.
And the crowns shall be for Chelem, and for Toviyah, and for Yedayah, and for Chen the son of Tzefanyah, as a memorial in the Temple of Havayah.
And distant ones shall come and build in the Temple of Havayah, and you shall know that Havayah of Hosts sent me to you. And it shall come to pass if you hearken to the voice of Havayah your Elokim.
And it came to pass in the fourth year of King Daryavesh; The word of Havayah came to Zecharyah on the fourth of the ninth month, in Kislev.
And Sharetzer and Regem-Melech Melech and his men sent to Beis El to pray before Havayah,
to say to the Priests of the house of Havayah of Hosts and to the prophets, saying, "Shall I weep in the fifth month, abstaining as I have done these many years?"
And the word of Havayah of Hosts came to me, saying:
Say to all the people of the land and to the priests saying: When you fasted and mourned in the fifth month and in the seventh month even these seventy years, did you fast for Me, even for Me?
And when you eat and when you drink — are you not the ones who eat and you the ones who drink?
Was it not the words that Havayah proclaimed through the former prophets, when Yerushalayim was settled and tranquil, and its cities were around it, and the Negev and the lowland were settled?
And the word of Havayah came to Zecharyah, saying:
So Havayah of Hosts said, saying: Execute true judgment and perform loving-kindness and mercy, each one of you to his brother.
Do not oppress the widow, the orphan, the stranger, or the poor man. Neither shall any of you think evil against his brother in your heart.
But they refused to listen; and they turned a rebellious shoulder; and they made their ears heavy, not to hear.

And they made their heart as hard as a shamir, in order not to listen to the Torah and to the words that Havayah of Hosts sent, through His spirit by the earlier prophets. And there was great anger from Havayah of Hosts.
And it came about; as He called and they did not hearken, so shall they call and I will not hearken, Havayah of Hosts said.

And with a whirlwind I will scatter them among all the nations whom they did not know. And the land shall be waste after them with no one passing through or returning. They made a precious land a desolation.
And the word of Havayah of Hosts came to me, saying:
So Havayah of Hosts said: I am jealous for Tziyon with great jealousy, and with great fury I am jealous for her.

So Havayah said: I will return to Tziyon, and I will dwell in the midst of Yerushalayim; and Yerushalayim shall be called the city of truth, and the mount of Havayah of Hosts shall be called the holy mountain.
So Havayah of Hosts said: Old men and women shall yet sit in the streets of Yerushalayim, each man with his staff in his hand because of old age.
And the streets of the city shall be filled, with boys and girls playing in its streets.
So Havayah of Hosts said: As it will be wonderful in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, it will also be wonderful in My eyes, Havayah of Hosts says.
So Havayah of Hosts said: Behold I will save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west.
And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Yerushalayim; and they shall be My people, and I shall be their Elokim, in truth and in righteousness.

So Havayah of Hosts said: Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets that were prophesying in the day that the foundation of the house of Havayah of Hosts was laid, even the Temple, that it might be built.

For before those days, there was no hire for man; neither was there any hire for beast. And for him that went out or came in, there was no peace because of the adversary, and I would incite all men, each one against his neighbor.
But now I am not the same to the remnant of this people as in the early days, Havayah of Hosts said.

For the sowing is for peace. The vine shall give forth its fruit, and the earth shall give forth its produce, and the heavens shall give forth their dew — and I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these.

And it shall come to pass that just as you were a curse among the nations, O house of Yehudah and house of Yisroel, so will I save you — and you shall be a blessing. Fear not; may your hands be strengthened!
For so Havayah of Hosts said: As I planned to do evil to you when your forefathers provoked Me — Havayah of Hosts said — and I did not repent,
so have I turned about. I have planned in these days to do good to Yerushalayim and to the house of Yehudah; do not fear.
These are the things that you shall do: Speak the truth each one with his neighbor; truth, and judgment of peace you shall judge in your cities.
And let no one think evil of his neighbors in your heart, nor shall you love a false oath — for all these are what I hate, Havayah says.
And the word of Havayah of Hosts came to me, saying:

So Havayah of Hosts said: The fast of the fourth month, the fast of the fifth month, the fast of the seventh month, and the fast of the tenth month shall be for the house of Yehudah for joy and happiness and for happy holidays — but love truth and peace.
So Havayah of Hosts said: There will yet be a time that peoples and the inhabitants of many cities shall come.
And the inhabitants of one shall go to another, saying, "Let us go to pray before Havayah and to entreat Havayah of Hosts. I, too, will go."
And many peoples and powerful nations shall come to entreat Havayah of Hosts in Yerushalayim, and to pray before Havayah.

So Havayah of Hosts said: In those days, when ten men of all the languages of the nations shall take hold of the skirt of a Yehudi man, saying, "Let us go with you, for we have heard that Elokim is with you."
The prophecy of the word of Havayah in the land of Chadrach. And Damesek is His resting place, for man's eye shall be to Havayah and all the tribes of Yisroel.
And also Chamas shall border thereon; also Tzor and Tzidon, for it has become exceedingly wise.
And Tzor built a fortification for herself, and she gathered silver like dust and gold like the mire of the streets.
Behold, Havayah shall impoverish her, and He shall smite her wealth in the sea, and she shall be consumed by fire.
Ashkelon shall see and fear, and Azah — and she shall quake violently — and Ekron, for the one to whom she looked was ashamed. And a king was lost from Azah, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
And the strangers shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Pelishtim.

And I will remove his blood from his mouth, and his detestable things from between his teeth. And it, too, shall remain to our Elokim: and it shall be like a studyhall in Yehudah; and Ekron, like Yevusi.
And I will encamp beside My house against a garrison of those passing by and of those returning. And no oppressor shall pass by them, for now I have seen with My eyes.

Be exceedingly happy, O daughter of Tziyon; Shout, O daughter of Yerushalayim. Behold! Your king shall come to you. He is just and victorious; humble, and riding a donkey and a foal, the offspring of one of she-donkeys.

And I will cut off the chariots from Efraim, and the horses from Yerushalayim; and the bow of war shall be cut off. And he shall speak peace to the nations, and his rule shall be from the sea to the west and from the river to the ends of the earth.
You, too — with the blood of your covenant I have freed your prisoners from a pit in which there was no water.
Return to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope. Also today, I will restore to you a double promise.
For I bend Yehudah for Me like a bow; I filled the hand of Efraim, and I will arouse your children, O Tziyon, upon your children, O Yavan; and I will make you as the sword of a mighty man.
And Havayah shall appear over them, and his arrows shall go forth like lightning. And Havayah Elokim shall sound the shofar, and He shall go with the whirlwinds of the south.

The Havayah of Hosts shall protect them, and they shall devour. And they shall tread the sling-stones, and they shall drink. They shall make a noise like those who drink wine, and they shall become full like the basin, like the corners of the altar.
And Havayah their Elokim shall save them on that day like the flocks of His people, for crown stones are exalted on His land.
For how great is their goodness and how great is their beauty! Corn will give strength to young men, and new wine will cause maids to speak.
Request rain from Havayah at the time of the latter rain; Havayah makes rain-clouds, and He shall give them rain; for each person, grass in the field.

For the teraphim spoke futility, and the soothsayers envisioned lies, and dreamers speak lies; they console with vanity. Therefore, they traveled like sheep; they were humbled, for there is no shepherd.
My wrath is kindled against the shepherds, and I will visit upon the goats, for Havayah of Hosts has remembered His flock, the house of Yehudah, and He has made it as His majestic horse in battle.
Out of them shall come the cornerstone; out of them, the stake; out of them, the bow of war. Out of them shall come every oppressor together.
And they shall be like mighty men, treading the mire of the streets in battle. And they shall wage war, for Havayah is with them. And they shall shame the riders of horses.

And I will strengthen the house of Yehudah, and the house of Yosef I will save. And I will cause them to settle, for I have bestowed mercy upon them. And they shall be as though I had not forsaken them, for I am Havayah their Elokim, and I will answer them.
And Efraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as if with wine. And their children shall see and rejoice; their heart shall be joyful with Havayah.
I will whistle to them, and I will gather them, for I have redeemed them. And they shall multiply as they multiplied.
And I will sow them among the peoples, and in the distant places they shall remember Me. And they shall live with their children and return.
And I will return them from the land of Mitzrayim, and from Ashur I will gather them. And to the land of Gilad and Levanon I will bring them, and it shall not suffice for them.

And trouble shall pass through the sea, and He shall strike the waves of the sea and dry all the depths of the river. And the pride of Ashur shall be brought down, and the rod of Mitzrayim shall turn away.
And I will strengthen them by Havayah, and by His Name they shall walk, Havayah says.
Open your doors, O Levanon, and let the fire consume your cedars.
Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen, for the mighty ones have been spoiled. Wail, O oaks of the Bashan, for the fortified forest has gone down.
Hearken to the wailing of the shepherds, for their glory has been spoiled. Hearken to the roar of the young lions, for the pride of the Yarden has been spoiled.
So Havayah said, my Elokim: Tend the flock of slaughter,
whose buyers shall slay them and not be guilty; and whose sellers shall say, "Blessed be Havayah, for I have become wealthy"; and whose shepherds shall not have pity on them.

For I will no longer have pity on the inhabitants of the land, Havayah says. And behold! I will deliver the men, each one into his neighbor's hand and into his king's hand. And they shall crush the land, and I will not save them from their hands.
And I tended the flock of slaughter; indeed, the poor of the flock. And I took for Myself two staffs; one I called Pleasantness, and one I called Destroyers; and I tended the flock.
I cut off the three shepherds in one month, I could not tolerate them; moreover, they were too much for Me.
And I said, "I will not tend you. That which dies — let it die; and that which is cut off — let it be cut off. And the survivors shall eat, each one her neighbor's flesh.
And I took My first staff, called Pleasantness and I cut it off to nullify My covenant that I had formed with all the peoples.
And it was nullified on that day. And the poor of the flock that kept My word knew this, that it was the word of Havayah.
And I said to them: "If it pleases you, give Me My hire, and if not, forbear." And they weighed out My hire: thirty pieces of silver.

And Havayah said to me: Cast it to the keeper of the treasury, to the stronghold of glory — of which I stripped them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and I cast it into the house of Havayah, to the keeper of the treasury.
And I cut off my second staff, the Destroyers, to nullify the brotherhood between Yehudah and Yisroel.
And Havayah said to me; Take for yourself still another thing, the instrument of a foolish shepherd.

For, behold! I am setting up a shepherd in the land. Those that are cut off he shall not remember; the foolish ones he shall not seek. The lame he shall not heal; the one that can stand he shall not bear. And the flesh of the fat one he shall eat, and their hoofs he shall break.
Ho, worthless shepherd, who abandons the flock! A sword is on his arm and his right eye; his arm shall wither, and his right eye shall dim.
The prophecy of the word of Havayah concerning Yisroel: Havayah says, Who stretches out the heavens and founds the earth and forms the spirit of man within him:
Behold! I am making Yerushalayim a cup of weakness for all the peoples around, and also on Yehudah, that he shall be in the siege against Yerushalayim.
And it shall come to pass on that day that I will make Yerushalayim a stone of burden for all peoples; all who bear it shall be gashed, and all the nations of the earth shall gather about it.

On that day, Havayah says, I will smite every horse with bewilderment, and its rider with madness. And upon the house of Yehudah I will open My eyes, and all the horses of the peoples I will smite with blindness.
And the princes of Yehudah shall say to themselves, "The inhabitants of Yerushalayim were my strength through Havayah of Hosts, their Elokim."

On that day I will make the princes of Yehudah as a fiery stove among wood, and as a brand of fire among sheaves. And they shall consume on the right and on the left all the nations round about, and Yerushalayim shall still stay in its place in Yerushalayim.
And Havayah shall first save the tents of Yehudah, so that the boasting of the house of Dovid and the boasting of the inhabitants of Yerushalayim shall not increase over Yehudah.

On that day Havayah shall protect the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and the weakest of them shall be, on that day, like Dovid. And the house of Dovid shall be like angels, like the angel of Havayah before them.
And it shall come to pass on that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come upon Yerushalayim.

And I will pour out upon the house of Dovid and upon the inhabitants of Yerushalayim a spirit of grace and supplications. And they shall look to me because of those who have been thrust through with swords, and they shall mourn over it as one mourns over an only son and shall be in bitterness, therefore, as one is embittered over a firstborn son.
On that day there shall be great mourning in Yerushalayim, like the mourning of Hadad-Rimmon in the Valley of Megiddo.
And the land shall mourn, every family apart: The family of the house of Dovid apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nasan apart, and their wives apart.
The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeim apart, and their wives apart.
All the remaining families — every family apart, and their wives apart.
On that day, a spring shall be opened for the house of Dovid and for the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, for purification and for sprinkling.

And it shall come to pass on that day, Havayah of Hosts says: I will cut off the names of the idols from the earth, and they shall no longer be mentioned. And also the prophets and the spirit of contamination I will remove from the earth.

And it shall come to pass, if a man still prophesies, that his father and his mother — his parents — shall say to him, "You shall not live, for you have spoken falsely in the name of Havayah." And his father and his mother — his parents — shall thrust him through because of his prophesying.
And it shall come to pass on that day that the prophets shall be ashamed, each one of his vision when he prophesies; and they will not wear a hairy mantle in order to lie.
And he shall say, "I am not a prophet! I am a tiller of the soil, for a man entrusted me with his cattle from my youth."
And one will say to him, "What are these wounds between your hands?" And he shall say, "That I was smitten in the house of my friends."

O sword, awaken against My shepherd and against the man who is associated with Me! Havayah of Hosts says. Smite the shepherd, and the flock shall scatter, and I will return My hand upon the little ones.
And it shall come to pass throughout all the land, Havayah says, two parts of it shall be cut off. They shall perish, and the third shall remain therein.

And I will bring the third in fire; and I will refine them as one refines silver, and I will test them as one tests gold. He shall call in My name, and I will respond to him. I said, "He is My people"; and he shall say, "The Havayah is my Elokim."
Behold! A day of Havayah is coming, and your plunder shall be shared within you.

And I will gather all the nations to Yerushalayim to wage war; and the city shall be captured, and the houses shall be plundered, and the women shall be ravished, and half the city shall go forth into exile — and the rest of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
And Havayah shall go forth and wage war with those nations, like the day he waged war on the day of the battle.

And on that day His feet shall stand on the Mount of Zeisim, which is before Yerushalayim from the east. And the Mount of Zeisim shall split in the midst thereof — toward the east and toward the west — a very great valley. And half the mountain shall move to the north, and half of it to the south.

And you shall flee to the valley of the mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach Atzal. And you shall flee as you fled because of the earthquake, in the days of Uziyahu the King of Yehudah. And Havayah, my Elokim, shall come; all holy ones with you.
And it shall come to pass on that day that there shall be no light, only disappearing light and thick darkness.
And it shall be one day that shall be known to Havayah, neither day nor night; and it shall come to pass that at eventide it shall be light.
And it shall come to pass on that day that spring water shall come forth from Yerushalayim; half of it to the eastern sea, and half of it to the western sea; in summer and in winter it shall be.
And Havayah shall become King over all the earth; on that day shall Havayah be one, and His name one.

The whole earth shall be changed to be like a plain, from the hill of Rimmon in the south of Yerushalayim; but it Yerushalayim will be elevated high and remain in its old place; from the gate of Binyamin to the place of the first gate, until the corner gate, and from the tower of Chananel until the king's wine — cellars.
And they shall dwell therein, and there shall be no more destruction; but Yerushalayim shall dwell in safety.

And this shall be the plague wherewith Havayah will smite all the nations who besieged Yerushalayim; his flesh will waste away while he still stands on his feet; his eyes will waste away in their sockets, and his tongue shall waste away in his mouth.

And it will come to pass on that day that there will be great consternation, sent by Havayah upon them; each one shall seize the hand of the other, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of the other.
Yea, even Yehudah will fight against Yerushalayim! And the wealth of all the nations round about — gold and silver and apparel — will be gathered in very great abundance.
And so will be the plague of the horses, the mules, the camels, the donkeys, and all the animals that are in those camps, similar to this plague.

And it will come to pass that everyone left of the nations who came up against Yerushalayim will go up from year to year to prostrate himself to the King, Havayah of Hosts, and to celebrate the festival of Sukkos.
And it shall be that whoever of all the families of the earth does not go up to Yerushalayim to prostrate himself to the King, Havayah of Hosts — upon them there shall be no rain.

And if the family of Mitzrayim does not go up and does not come, it shall not rain upon them. The plague on Mitzrayim will be the same as that with which Havayah will plague the nations who do not go up to celebrate the festival of Sukkos.
Such will be the punishment of Mitzrayim and the punishment of all the nations who do not go up to celebrate the festival of Sukkos.
On that day there will be upon the bells of the horses, "holy to Havayah"; and the pots in the House of Havayah will be like the sprinkling bowls before the altar.

Yea, every pot in Yerushalayim and in Yehudah will be holy to Havayah of Hosts, and all who sacrifice will come and take of them and cook in them; and there will no longer be a trafficker in the House of Havayah of Hosts on that day.
